Legal Debate Simulation v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enable one-stop "opposing counsel simulation" for legal argument attack & defense drills.
- Provides 5-dimension specific attack points and actionable defense strategies based on user-supplied facts, law, and claims.
- Supports full sandbox role-play for "mock trial" scenario testing, including argument weakness analysis and role reversal.
- Simple input and output structure; designed for concise, practical legal prep use.
